viewer.wasmNotSyncedDesc: Expected files under /public/wasm/cunning_player/: index.html, cunning_player.js, cunning_player_bg.wasm.
viewer.wasmNotSyncedHint: Run pnpm predev (or pnpm build) in Cunning3d_website to copy the player web output into public/.

submitPage.title: Submit to Showcase
submitPage.desc: Upload a .cda (and an optional cover image) to create a GitHub Pull Request. After review, it will appear on the public Showcase.

submit.oauthNotConfigured: GitHub OAuth is not configured on this deployment yet. Ask the site owner to set GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_OAUTH_COOKIE_SECRET.
submit.uploadDesc: Provide a .cda and (optionally) a cover image. Keep it small—PRs are reviewed manually.
submit.signInHint: Sign in with GitHub first to prevent anonymous spam.
submit.manualPrDesc: If automatic upload is unavailable, you can still contribute by opening a PR that adds your .cda (and a same-name cover image) into public/examples/.
